items.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world's online shopping data
items.rationale: Amazon building a web-wide product graph for AI shopping search changes where product listings must be discoverable and where shopping ads will sit.
items.excerpt: A vault of data on every product on the internet.

items.title: Amazon caps its automated DVA+ campaigns at 20 products
items.rationale: Concrete new guide (Nov 13) for Amazon's AI-steered DVA+ campaigns: 20-product cap, seven objectives, learning reset on KPI changes - directly changes how buyers set up campaigns.
items.excerpt: Seven objectives, three build modes and a learning reset on KPI changes await DVA+ buyers. What does the November 13 guide leave out on audio and on launching?

items.title: AI-derived audience insights hurt results: What the numbers say
items.rationale: New report data: over 80% of leaders saw a negative business outcome from inaccurate AI audience outputs - a caution for AI-driven targeting.
items.excerpt: Over 80% of industry leaders have experienced at least one negative business outcome due to inaccurate AI outputs, per a recent report.

items.title: New Data: Holiday Shoppers Will Rely on Agents. Retailers Must Be Ready.
items.rationale: Primary-source holiday survey: ~20% of shoppers start with AI, but most won't let agents pay - sets expectations for agentic commerce this season.
items.excerpt: A Salesforce survey shows that holiday shoppers are using AI agents for research and advice — almost 20% of shoppers now say that AI is their first stop on the way to the store — but most aren't ready to let AI click Buy Now.

items.title: Pinterest adds holiday shopping tools
items.rationale: Pinterest's shopping assistant gains trending gift guides plus product comparison and wish lists - a new AI shopping surface brands can show up in for Q4.
items.excerpt: The platform updated its chatbot with trending gift guides and introduced product comparison tools and wish lists.
